# file-sharer

> Private, end-to-end encrypted sharing of text and files between your own devices.

## Product

- [file-sharer homepage](https://file-sharer.4oli.com/): Create or link a private space without an account.
- [How file-sharer works](https://file-sharer.4oli.com/how-it-works/): Create a space, pair devices and share text and files.
- [Security model](https://file-sharer.4oli.com/security/): Client-side encryption, device keys and QR-code pairing.
- [Privacy overview](https://file-sharer.4oli.com/privacy/): What stays local, what the server receives and retention.
- [Install file-sharer](https://file-sharer.4oli.com/install/): Use the app as an installable progressive web app.
- [Sitemap](https://file-sharer.4oli.com/sitemap.xml): Public URLs for the application.

## Key features

- Messages, files, and file metadata are encrypted on the device before upload.
- The server receives ciphertext, public keys, authentication data, hashes, and delivery metadata — not message or file plaintext.
- Devices can be paired with a QR code, and the installable PWA can save outgoing messages or selected files locally; uploads and delivery require a connection.
